description_en: Enables or disables the log search feature for a specified domain name
description_zh: 为指定域名开启或关闭日志检索功能
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-log-retrieval-status --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --domain www.example.com --enabled 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLogRetrievalStatus

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的WAF实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name that has been added.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html to query all added domain names
parameters.help_zh:
已添加的域名名称。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html查询所有已经添加的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the log search feature. Valid values:

0: disables the feature.

1: enables the feature.

WAF records access request logs for a domain name only after the log search feature is enabled for the domain name. If you disable the log search feature, access request logs during the disabled period are not recorded. Even if you re-enable the log search feature, you cannot query access request logs generated during the disabled period
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启日志检索功能，取值：

0：表示关闭。

1：表示开启。

只有为域名开启日志检索功能后，WAF才会记录该域名的访问请求日志。如果您关闭日志检索功能，则处于关闭状态期间的访问请求日志不会被记录；即使重新开启日志检索功能，您也无法查询到停用期间的访问请求日志
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_zh:
